name: municipal permit office, fluorescent weekday
desc: The clerical floor of a municipal permit office: three rows of grey steel desks under banks of fluorescent tubes, each desk stacked with manila folders, ink pads and rubber stamps. Beige filing cabinets line one wall, frosted windows the other, and a round institutional clock hangs on the far wall. A long service counter separates the clerks from the public. Adapted for Anubis, not part of the Roko novel.
